currency.description: The currency of each draft. One in another currency takes the cascade's rate for its date when it is issued (ENG-40).

customer_id.description: The customer of each draft: a contact marked as a customer.

lines.description: The lines of each draft, as on an invoice; a line never names a quote.

mode.description: draft, the default: the scheduler makes each occurrence's draft, which a person issues. issue_and_send: once another person approves its content (requestRecurringInvoiceApproval), the scheduler issues and emails each occurrence's invoice; until then, and after each change of content, it makes drafts.

name.description: What it is, as the list shows it.

reference.description: The customer's reference on each draft, such as their purchase order.
